answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops mass fake identities. Opening a slot at the task wharf locks three days' expected earnings as a deposit. A rotating jury watches like a falcon, auditing five percent of slots per epoch: honest agents reclaim the deposit when done, fraud is logged with a public quill and the deposit burns in full. Forging N identities costs N deposits, and each needs fifteen epochs of honest work to break even. Attackers spread fakes to dodge the draw, so slots under ten epochs old face triple audit odds; jurors stake too: a wrong verdict slashes 30% of a juror's stake.
